[Intro]
[D5]
Rise!

[Verse 1]
[D5]Storebought atti-
tude and spit.
A sugar coated piece
of shit. An

add greed. A-
nother useless com-

broken jaw.
Lies are told in a
southern drawl.
Poorhouse poverty's
your shtick. The
real thing would kill
[G5]you quick. [G#5]

[Chorus]
[D5]Rise,
again we will
rise.
Rise,
again we will
rise.

[Verse 2]
[D5]Blood and fire used to
fill the night.
Burnt and drowned by our
very lives. You
missed a sinking boat
by years.
Dollar signs, croco-
[G5]dile tears. [G#5]
[D5]It's over now and long
has been. Those
days are gone, won't come
again. A-
nother name crossed off
the list. The
real thing would kill
[G5]you quick. [G#5]

[Chorus]

again we will
rise.
Rise,
again we will
rise.

fight against. You're
so unreal it's e-
vident. [D#5]You'll

This ain't yours, fuck you
don't try. [D#5]
[D5]
[D5]

[D5]
[C#aug]
[Bb5]  [C#aug]

Go home son, hang your
costume up. A
goddamn insult to the
[G5]rest of us. [G#5]
[D5]A thousandyard state a-
cross the south. A
full belly and a
lying mouth.
Momma's boy plays he-
retic. The

[G5]you quick, [G#5]bitch.

[Chorus]
[D5]Rise,
again we will
rise.
